svg.title: Three separate optimization levers
svg.desc: Prefix reuse chooses fresh query work, paging maps logical KV to physical slots, and tiled attention avoids full intermediates. Combining them requires compatible contracts.

g.text: 1. Prefix reuse: which query rows must be evaluated?
Validate complete token history, computation identity and sharing authority.
Reused KV remains available to suffix and decode queries.
2. Paged KV: where are the historical keys and values?
A logical block table selects protected pool slots and valid rows.
The consumer must understand the actual dtype, strides and head mapping.
3. Tiled attention: how are scores and weighted state consumed?
Consume score fragments with scale-correct online state.
Avoid full S/P only when the public output contract does not require them.
Combination requires eligible executables, correct numerics and retained ownership.
